data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025 (Denmark country note) synthesises multiple education-system indicators using the latest available reference years, with a thematic emphasis on tertiary education. The note reports descriptive comparisons across OECD countries for outcomes such as tertiary attainment by parental education, unemployment rates by educational attainment, employment and wage differentials by qualification level, and adult literacy proficiency distributions from the Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC). It also documents trends over time (e.g., unemployment trends from 2008–2024; literacy score changes between PIAAC Cycle 1 and Cycle 2) and system inputs such as government expenditure per student and teacher turnover. Because the note does not present an original student-level modeling framework (no ML training, no PV-based estimation procedure, and no explicit sampling/weighting details), it should be interpreted as policy-relevant descriptive evidence rather than as causal or predictive results.
